name: @eeyzs1/dsh-llm-transport-recovery
description: Two-phase recovery for DeepSeek TRANSPORT failures: 5 normal HTTP/1.1 retries within a 2-min window, then a recovery path (fresh DNS + all-IP fallback + brand-new connections) up to a bounded budget (5+15=20 total), then the turn fails like stock DSH. Phase is tracked per session; compaction gets bounded auto-retry. The connect budget bounds ONLY the TCP/TLS connect phase, so slow servers (huge context + reasoning) are not killed before they respond. Logs full error chains.
